title: Mash Potatoes Pannekoek
ingredients: Parmesan mash + corn starch (like 60g/8tblsp for 6 potatoes), make a dough by kneading a bit, wrap mozarella in dough, fry 4-7 mins
Also try 125g flour baking powder one egg and chives
